sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob.
Whether it be along a recent battlefield, an abandoned dungeon...
The Memorial Mob will make an appearance.
If you seek them out, they'll surely present their wares.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: - Mibu Village: in front of the Sculptor's Idol.

sections.heading: Fountainhead Palace (Fountainhead Palace)
sections.text: Upon defeating the Corrupted Monk, the Dragon's Tally Board she drops will unlock new items at every merchant.

sections.heading: Ashina Outskirts ( Outskirts Wall - Stairway )
sections.text: Complete Anayama's questline (see his page for in depth info) to acquire the Promissory Note, which will discount by 10% the cost of every item sold by merchants.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text:
First Encounter with a Mob | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
Wolf: An offering?
Memorial Mob: Indeed. I sell items to be offered to the dead, so they might rest in peace. From the looks of you, I'd wager you have a lot of blood on your hands. ...go ahead, buy an offering. (Mischievous chuckling.)
First Encounter | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
Wolf: Another one...
Memorial Mob: Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob... Even those who can't die still have use for offerings! ... go ahead, buy an offering. Heehee, heeheehee!
Leaving | Memorial Mob: Where you find the departed, you'll find the Memorial Mob... Wherever your travels take you, make sure you bring some offerings with you. Heehee, heeheehee!
Greeting (Generic) | Memorial Mob: Care to purchase an offering?
Leaving (Generic) | Memorial Mob: May the departed rest in peace...
When Infected with Dragonrot | Memorial Mob: More sake... I just need... more sake... (Wheeze... Wheeze...) Not enough sake, that means... I must... make an offering...

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- When bought, the Mottled Purple Gourd will only have 1 use out of 5 available.
- The only merchant to sell Gachiin's Sugars, Treasure Carp Scales and Dragonspring Sake.
- Despite them being Key Items, the Treasure Carp Scales and Dragonspring Sake sold by this merchant will be available for purchase again in New Game Plus.
